name: Test
overview: Ilya lives in his girlfriend's apartment, spends his life playing computer games, is not burdened with plans for the future and is one step away from being expelled. Everything changes when a girl goes to Sochi for a bachelorette party with a friend, and he finds a positive pregnancy test. In a panic, he packs up and leaves for a friend's house. But there, looking at yesterday's pizza and stale things, he begins to reflect that living with a girl is not so bad and maybe it's worth looking towards starting a family. He goes to his beloved's father for advice.
